mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 forward returns: lower rates predict positive returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in low FEDFUNDS periods (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day returns in interacting periods (FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rising) are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a federal funds rate above 4.5% predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in low UNRATE periods (UNRATE < 4.0%) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5% and rising > 0.2pp in 1 month) signals an economic slowdown that increases equity risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5% and rising > 0.2pp in 1 month), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand that increases equity risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day returns in interacting periods (HOUST and RSAFS both declining) are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In the regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 110.0), a falling industrial production index predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. In the regime of rising industrial production (INDPRO >= 110.0), the same signal predicts positive returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 110.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
